resources.string: Enter the address of your OpenTodo server, the one you open in the browser.
This address can\'t be used. Enter an address such as todo.example.com.
This address needs a secure connection (https).
This address is on your local network and isn\'t encrypted: others on the same network could read what you send. Tap again to connect anyway.
No connection. The first start needs the network; this screen tries again when it\'s back.
This address doesn\'t answer like an OpenTodo server. Check the address.
This phone doesn\'t trust the server\'s certificate. Ask whoever runs the server, or install their certificate authority in Android settings.
This removes the current server\'s data from this phone: the offline copy, scheduled reminders, widget data and fingerprint unlock. Changes not yet synced are lost.
The server can\'t be reached, and OpenTodo hasn\'t been opened on this phone before.
This phone doesn\'t trust the server\'s certificate.
Reminders will show up like this.
Opens OpenTodo to add a task
Open OpenTodo once to fill this widget.
This phone\'s Android System WebView is old (version %1$s). Update it from your app store so OpenTodo works fully.
